talia: did a quick a11y sweep on the new Alerts panel this AM. a few small but important things to surface here: talia: 1) Focus order when opening the alert details drawer is off 1 focus lands on the first interactive in the main content instead of the drawer close button talia: 2) the severity badges rely on color only; screen readers don't get a semantic name for high/medium/low talia: 3) inline dismiss toasts are visually subtle and not announced; we currently add them to the DOM but no live region update jia: thanks 1 can you paste the drawer markup you saw? is it using the SidePanel like other components? talia: yes it's our SidePanel variant. markup looks like: ```

Alert: Model latency spike

...
``` jia: if it's our SidePanel we should follow the same fix as the other drawer bugs: move focus into the panel on open (focus the close button), trap focus while open, and on close restore focus to the invoking button. also add `aria-labelledby` pointing to the h2 so SRs read context on open marisol: for severity badges, add an accessible name like `Severity: high` or use `role="status" aria-label="High severity"` depending on whether we want it announced when it changes. avoid duplicating visible text for SRs talia: agreed. for the toasts I suggest using a polite `aria-live` region and short summaries: e.g., "Alert dismissed" and aggregate repeated events into "3 alerts dismissed" to avoid spam. ensure toasts are not `aria-hidden` in any theme a11y-bot: quick scan (alerts-panel/2026-04-20) 4 issues flagged: 3 (1 high: focus not restored on dialog close; 1 medium: severity badges missing accessible name). See https://ci.redwood/axe/scan/4012 jia: proposed owner breakdown: me -> drawer focus + aria-labelledby; marisol -> severity badge SR names; talia -> toast live-region batching + tests. will add test steps and a small e2e that opens drawer, tabs, closes, and asserts focus returns to the opener talia: i'll implement a small announcer util and unit tests. will also include a Storybook example showing toasts announced with VoiceOver/NVDA notes marisol: i'll update the badge component and add an accessibility variant in tokens for the color+text pattern. will run a dark-theme axe scan after changes jia: creating tickets and adding acceptance criteria: 1) open drawer -> SR announces title and focus is inside panel; 2) close drawer -> focus returns to trigger and SR reads "Alert details closed"; 3) severity badges have accessible names; 4) toasts announced politely and batched. tagging @eng-accessibility and @qa in the PRs talia: thanks all 1 will post PR links and axe scan results here. closing thread when scans are green.
